name: The Middle East War
overview: The Scriptures reveal a prophetic vision of intense conflict in the Middle East during the end times, characterized by fierce battles between the 'king of the south' and the 'king of the north,' as described in Daniel 11:40. This period will be marked by unprecedented trouble, yet God's protection is assured through Michael, the great prince who stands for His people (Daniel 12:1). The Lord will ultimately bring judgment upon those who fight against Jerusalem, executing a severe plague as a divine response to their rebellion (Zechariah 14:12). These events unfold within God's sovereign plan to restore His people and fulfill His promises, as seen in the gathering of Judah and Jerusalem from captivity (Joel 3:1).
